methodology.normalization: x_1080=x_source*1080/width; y_1440=y_source*1440/height; no destructive image resize
methodology.box_uncertainty: Raster threshold boundaries usually ±1–3 source pixels, not absolute vector geometry. Source JPEG compression introduces ringing.
methodology.layout_regions: Semantic ROIs selected manually from viewed originals, then dark-pixel bbox extracted with maxRGB<95 (card edges) or maxRGB<190 (text). Bounding boxes are half-open.
methodology.flow_arrows: I185 connectors touch cards; require horizontal dark coverage >55% of panel width to isolate long border rows.
methodology.rounding: Least-squares quarter-circle fit to the upper-left outer dark edge. Report fitted radius and RMSE; this approximates the raster boundary and does not establish original CSS radius.
methodology.stroke: Median length of the first dark run at the upper straight edge over 30–70% width. Solid black bands have no separately observable stroke.
methodology.shadow: Find the first contiguous flat-color run immediately outside right/bottom straight edges; L∞ RGB distance <22 and strip coverage >60%. Distance is exposed painted extent, not guaranteed source design offset.
methodology.grid: Empty edge-strip average RGB brightness; line threshold is strip median minus 2.5. Grid centers come from contiguous runs; line support width is threshold dependent, not inferred CSS stroke.
methodology.palette: Median/mode in stored source-pixel patches, except I174 mint header uses an explicit color filter to remove background.
methodology.fonts: No font identity, font file, exact font size, original prompt, model seed or model token IDs can be uniquely recovered from the raster.
